stages.summary: Stdlib Python counter service with lock-guarded counter, Dockerfile and RUN.md. Reviewer verified from a clean git archive: all four endpoints per spec, 600 concurrent increments gave exactly 600, harness passes stage 1 (stage 2 errors as expected).

Stdlib Python payments/settlements service behind a single global lock, scrypt password hashes, atomic reset/import swap. Reviewer verified from a clean git archive with 2 CPUs and 2 GiB: all endpoints and the error table, five idempotent write paths including 50-way concurrent replays, money invariants under 50 concurrent requests, split rounding, activity feed visibility, export/import round trip and settlements. Harness passes stage 1 (stage 2 errors as expected; harness covers only part of the full tests). Reviewer made three minor non-blocking notes to the builder.
